name: moroi
description: a Moroi (Fall from Heaven), an elite Calabim warrior fed on vampire blood: chalk-white skin, glowing red eyes, small fangs bared in a snarl, long black hair under a black steel open helmet with a nose guard, a high black collar, a deep crimson tabard with a black and silver bat-wing clasp over a blackened chain-mail shirt with mail pauldrons, bare chalk-white upper arms, black leather bracers, a black belt, black boots, and a big battle axe with a crimson-wrapped haft and a broad crescent steel blade, gripped by the end of its haft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the battle axe's haft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the haft higher up, near the blade, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the haft, the battle axe is lifted beside the helmet with its steel blade pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the axe hand behind the helmet and the battle axe's blade hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the crimson tabard
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the axe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the battle axe is level, its steel blade pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: axe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the battle axe's blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the red eyes fixed on the lower-right, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the battle axe carries on down until its blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the black hair and the crimson tabard trailing back, the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the battle axe comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the left hand reaching for the haft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, red eyes squeezed shut, fangs bared, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (axe arm thrown up and out to the left, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the battle axe dipping, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, axe arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the helmeted head droops, the battle axe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the battle axe's blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the battle axe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the black helmet on his head and the black hair spread on the ground; the battle axe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the helmet and the crimson tabard stay on
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the chalk-white face still, the battle axe on the ground beside him
